Summary

  • Design and execute comprehensive plans to ensure the successful integration of Rivet systems within government and commercial organizations

  • Act as the customer voice, advocating for key needs with Rivet engineering teams to ensure successful deliveries and depth growth within programs

  • Partner with commercial and engineering teams to translate customer needs into structured, competitive proposals aligned with Rivet’s capabilities and roadmap

  • Anticipate potential deployment challenges and devise solutions to minimize risks and smooth transitions

  • Track deployment activities, provide regular updates to stakeholders, and ensure that all milestones are met within the established timelines

  • Develop customer-specific roadmaps, proposing opportunities for Rivet and customers to create new value together or in cooperation with third parties

  • Deliver demos and presales vision materials to new and existing customers

  • Qualify potential engagements in expanding locations around the world

  • Own aspects of business development by scoping technical approaches, defining deployment strategies, and authoring customer proposals

  • 5+ years owning technical solution sales and/or customer-facing outcomes

Summary

The Office Manager is responsible for creating an organized, welcoming, and high-functioning workplace that enables employees to do their best work. This role oversees day-to-day office operations, facilities coordination, workplace organization, employee experience, and visitor management while serving as the primary point of contact for office-related needs. The ideal candidate is proactive, detail-oriented, highly organized, and enjoys creating exceptional workplace experiences.

Responsibilities

Office Operations & Organization

  • Purchase, stock, and manage office supplies, snacks, beverages, and other workplace essentials.

  • Maintain organized storage areas, including shelves, bins, cabinets, and supply rooms.

  • Ensure shared spaces—including the kitchen, lobby, conference rooms, and common areas—remain clean, organized, and presentable.

  • Identify opportunities to improve office efficiency and organization.

Facilities Management

  • Manage office layout and workspace planning to support current and future team growth.

  • Continuously improve the office environment, including décor, furnishings, and overall aesthetics.

  • Coordinate with building management regarding maintenance, deliveries, access, and facility-related requests.

  • Work with IT and external vendors to resolve issues with printers, conference room technology, and other office equipment.

  • Manage incoming and outgoing shipments and package distribution.

Workstation & Onboarding Support

  • Prepare workstations for new employees, including desks, monitors, peripherals, and accessories.

  • Maintain existing workstations by organizing cables, equipment, and storage areas.

  • Serve as the local point of contact for new hire onboarding, ensuring workstations, badges, and office logistics are ready before employees arrive.

  • Partner with IT and People Operations to deliver a seamless onboarding experience.

Visitor Experience

  • Manage the visitor registration system (Envoy) and ensure a smooth guest check-in process.

  • Welcome and host visitors, customers, and interview candidates.

  • Prepare conference rooms and demo stations for customer meetings and presentations.

  • Help create a professional and memorable experience for all office guests.

Employee Experience

  • Coordinate catered meals, snacks, and office events.

  • Plan and organize team activities, celebrations, and off-site events that foster employee engagement.

  • Capture high-quality photos of office events, team activities, and workplace moments for internal communications and marketing.

  • Support initiatives that enhance company culture and create an enjoyable workplace environment.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in office management, workplace operations, facilities, or administrative operations.

  • Strong organizational, multitasking, and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.

  • Experience coordinating vendors, building management, office supplies, facilities, and workplace logistics.

  • Experience supporting employee onboarding, visitor management, office events, and employee experience.

  • Proficiency with workplace tools such as Envoy, Google Workspace/Microsoft 365, Slack, and basic office/IT equipment.

Compensation may vary within the posted range based on relevant experience, skills, education, and other job-related factors.
